If I pay Zakat from this amount, I will not be having Rs 42,000 to pay to my house owner as 6 months rent which I have to pay after 3 months, but I believe Allah will arrange some amount Inshallah. I have not told about the amount which I have with me (i.e., RS 21,000) to my parents, as if I tell them they will ask for the money as they have lot of debt. They had become debt as they did lavish expenses at the time of my brother marriage (Lavish expenses like purchase of clothes worth Rs 10,000 each and distributing chocolate box and giving grand party etc.) Total they spend approx. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 67870 Country: Usa Title: Will zakah be paid if poor and needy ones are fed in the mosque? Question: Does feeding fellow brothers and sisters at a mosque count for zakah? Many of which come from poor families but not all. Answer ID: 67870 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1135/1146/N=11/1437) Zakah shall not be paid by feeding poor and needy ones in the mosque or somewhere else as tamlik (giving in the possession of poor) is a condition for the payment of zakah, while the condition of tamlik is missing in case of feeding on dining table as only it is permission ( ibahat ) to eat. However, if poor and those eligible for zakah are made owner of the food with the intention of zakah then zakah shall be paid equal to the price of food. قال الله تعالى: إنما الصدقت للفقراء والمساكين الآية (سوره توبه آيت: 60)، وقال الحصكفي فى الدر (مع الرد كتاب الزكاة ، باب المصرف 3: 291 ط مكتبة زكريا ديوبند): يصرف المزكي إلى كلهم أو إلى بعضهم، .......ويشترط أن يكون الصرف تمليكا لا إباحة اهـ ، وفى الرد: قوله: "تمليكاً" : فلا يكفي فيها الإطعام إلا بطريق التمليك ، ولو أطعمه عنده ناوياً الزكاة لا تكفي ، ط اهـ. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
